_readme: Producer-sourced facts only. Each entry needs source.url (official producer/brand page) and every field must come from that page. Leave a field out if the page does not state it. Run: node tools/apply-bottle-profiles.mjs

yamazaki-12-year.about: Yamazaki is Japan's first and oldest malt whisky distillery, established in 1923 by Shinjiro Torii. Yamazaki 12 Years Old is a single malt made from whisky aged in American, Spanish and Japanese Mizunara oak.
yamazaki-12-year.nose: Peach, pineapple, grapefruit, clove, candied orange, vanilla and Mizunara (Japanese oak)
yamazaki-12-year.finish: Sweet ginger and cinnamon, with a long finish
yamazaki-12-year.casks: American, Spanish and Japanese Mizunara oak

yamazaki-18-year.about: Yamazaki is Japan's first and oldest malt whisky distillery, established in 1923 by Shinjiro Torii. House of Suntory presents the 18 Years Old as its flagship single malt, made from whisky aged in American, Spanish and Japanese Mizunara oak.
yamazaki-18-year.nose: Raisin, apricot, cafe au lait and Mizunara (Japanese oak)
yamazaki-18-year.palate: Blackberry, strawberry jam and dark chocolate
yamazaki-18-year.casks: American, Spanish and Japanese Mizunara oak
awards: Supreme Champion Spirit, International Spirits Challenge 2025

eagle-rare-10-year.about: Eagle Rare has been produced at the Buffalo Trace Distillery since 1989. This Kentucky straight bourbon is aged for 10 years and is made from the distillery's Mash Bill #1.
eagle-rare-10-year.nose: Toffee, hints of orange peel, herbs, honey, leather and oak
eagle-rare-10-year.palate: Bold, dry and delicate, with candied almonds and very rich cocoa
eagle-rare-10-year.casks: Aged 10 years; Mash Bill #1 (the distillery does not publish grain percentages on this page)
awards: Gold, North American Bourbon and Whiskey Competition 2024

makers-mark-original.about: Maker's Mark is made at Star Hill Farm in Kentucky and uses soft red winter wheat in place of rye, which the distillery says gives a softer, sweeter style. Each bottle is hand-dipped in wax.
makers-mark-original.nose: Sweet oak, vanilla, bright fruit and wheat
makers-mark-original.palate: Sweet, with a balance of oak, vanilla and fruity notes
makers-mark-original.finish: Smooth and creamy, with a soft spice and a clean finish
awards: Ranked #6 in Drinks International's Most Admired Whiskies, 2025 edition

hibiki-21-year.about: Hibiki is House of Suntory's blended Japanese whisky range, which the brand describes as celebrating an unrivaled art of blending. This is the 21 Years Old expression.
hibiki-21-year.nose: Cooked fruit, blackberry, ripe banana and caramel
hibiki-21-year.palate: Sandalwood, honeycomb, dried apricot and Mizunara (Japanese oak)
hibiki-21-year.finish: Long and rich, with an incense aroma

yamazaki-25-year.about: Yamazaki is Suntory's flagship single malt, made at Japan's first and oldest malt whisky distillery. The range includes 12, 18 and 25 year old expressions, with components aged in American, Spanish and Japanese Mizunara oak.
yamazaki-25-year.nose: Smoky Mizunara notes of incense, followed by a complex bouquet of mature kaki persimmon and ume plum
yamazaki-25-year.palate: A smoky first sip of Mizunara sandalwood that deepens into kaki persimmon sweetness, tart ume plum and gentle shoga ginger spice
yamazaki-25-year.finish: Profound and long, with Mizunara smokiness and lingering, subtly sweet wood notes
yamazaki-25-year.casks: American, Spanish and Japanese Mizunara oak (range description)
awards: Double Gold Medal, International Spirits Challenge 2026
Japanese Whisky Category Trophy, International Spirits Challenge 2026

hakushu-12-year.about: Hakushu is Suntory's mountain forest distillery, set deep in Mt. Kaikomagatake. House of Suntory describes the 12 Years Old as a crisp and gently smoky single malt with herbal notes.
hakushu-12-year.nose: Basil, pine needle and green apple

pappy-van-winkle-20-year-family-reserve.about: The Van Winkle family has been producing bourbon for over a century. This 20 year old bourbon is made from the family wheated mash and bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV).
pappy-van-winkle-20-year-family-reserve.palate: Intense and tantalizing, smooth with a citrus zest note, with some sherry notes, dried fruits and vanilla
awards: Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2019
Best Bourbon / Best Small Batch Bourbon, New York World Wine & Spirits Competition 2018

pappy-van-winkle-15-year.about: This bourbon is crafted from the exclusive Van Winkle family wheated recipe and matured undisturbed for 15 years in deep-charred heavy oak. It is bottled at 107 proof (53.5% ABV).
pappy-van-winkle-15-year.nose: An elegant and sweet aroma of caramel corn and vanilla
pappy-van-winkle-15-year.palate: Big flavor of leather, oak and complex fruitiness
pappy-van-winkle-15-year.finish: Smooth, with notes of spice and oak tannins
pappy-van-winkle-15-year.casks: Matured 15 years in deep-charred heavy oak; wheated mash
awards: Overall Winner, World Whiskies Awards (Whisky Magazine) 2018
Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2019
Best Bourbon / Best Small Batch Bourbon, New York World Wine & Spirits Competition 2018

blantons-original-single-barrel.about: Blanton's is billed as the world's first single barrel bourbon. It is aged in Warehouse H, the only metal-clad warehouse at Buffalo Trace Distillery, and each bottle is hand-dumped, individually bottled, labeled and sealed. It is bottled at 93 proof (46.5% ABV) from Mash Bill #2.
blantons-original-single-barrel.nose: A deep, satisfying nose of nutmeg and spices
blantons-original-single-barrel.palate: Powerful dry vanilla in harmony with hints of honey amid strong caramel and corn
blantons-original-single-barrel.finish: Medium, with returning corn and nutmeg flavors
blantons-original-single-barrel.casks: Single barrel; Mash Bill #2; aged in Warehouse H
awards: Gold, Los Angeles International Wine & Spirits Competition 2019

michters-us1-bourbon.about: Michter's US★1 honors the brand's heritage, which it traces back to America's first whiskey company. Each small batch is blended in a holding tank of no more than twenty full barrels, and no US★1 whiskey is released until Master Distiller Dan McKee and the tasting panel approve it. Bottled at 91.4 proof (45.7% ABV).
michters-us1-bourbon.casks: Fire-charred, new American white oak barrels; small batch
michters-us1-bourbon.profile: Rich caramel with balanced vanilla, stone fruit notes and smoky depth, with an oak finish

michters-10-year-bourbon.about: Michter's 10 Year is a single barrel Kentucky straight bourbon, distilled and bottled in Kentucky and aged for over a decade in fire-charred, new American white oak. It is bottled at 94.4 proof (47.2% ABV). A private barrel selection of this whiskey sold at auction in London for £166,000, according to Michter's.
michters-10-year-bourbon.casks: Single barrel; fire-charred, new American white oak
michters-10-year-bourbon.profile: Big and bold dark toffee and caramel, charred oak, maple syrup and vanilla

johnnie-walker-blue-label.about: Johnnie Walker Blue Label is a blended Scotch whisky. Johnnie Walker says only one in 10,000 casks is hand-selected to craft it, including casks from long-closed ghost distilleries. The US bottling is 40% ABV.
johnnie-walker-blue-label.profile: A combination of vanilla, honey and rose petals, with sumptuous waves of smoke

jim-beam-original-white-label.about: Jim Beam credits seven generations of the Beam family. Its Original Kentucky straight bourbon is aged for 4 years in newly charred oak barrels, twice what the law requires for straight bourbon.
jim-beam-original-white-label.nose: Oaky vanilla with a spicy backdrop
jim-beam-original-white-label.palate: Medium-bodied, with mellow hints of caramel and vanilla
jim-beam-original-white-label.finish: Hints of spice and a classic bourbon finish
jim-beam-original-white-label.casks: Aged 4 years in newly charred oak barrels

wild-turkey-101.about: Wild Turkey says it has made 101 the same way for over 60 years. The bourbon is aged 6 to 8 years in American white oak barrels with the deepest alligator char, and its mash has a high rye content. It is bottled at 101 proof.
wild-turkey-101.palate: A hint of sweet up front with vanilla and caramel, then oak and baking spices mid-palate
wild-turkey-101.finish: Bold, signature Wild Turkey spice and orange peel
wild-turkey-101.casks: Aged 6 to 8 years; American white oak with deepest alligator char; high rye mash

makers-mark-cellar-aged.about: Maker's Mark Cellar Aged is an annual limited release, first launched in 2023. It is a blend of 11, 12 and 14 year old Maker's Mark, aged for roughly the first 7 years in the warehouses and then a further 4 to 6 years in a limestone cellar built into Star Hill Farm.
makers-mark-cellar-aged.nose: Complex, with dark cherry, clove, vanilla bean and soft orchard fruit
makers-mark-cellar-aged.palate: Enveloping, with honey, brown sugar and plums
makers-mark-cellar-aged.finish: A warming, silky finish with hints of almond, nutmeg and crisp green apple
makers-mark-cellar-aged.casks: Blend of 11, 12 and 14 year old bourbon; final 4 to 6 years in a limestone cellar

michters-25-year-bourbon.about: Michter's 25 Year is a limited production Kentucky straight bourbon, distilled and bottled in Kentucky and aged in fire-charred, new American white oak barrels. It is bottled at 116.2 proof (58.1% ABV) and sold only as stock allows.
michters-25-year-bourbon.casks: 25 years old; fire-charred, new American white oak; select mashbill
michters-25-year-bourbon.profile: Molasses, holiday spice, chocolate, smoke-roasted nuts, dried fruit, melted butter and vanilla

macallan-18-double-cask.about: The Macallan Double Cask 18 Years Old is matured for 18 years in sherry seasoned American and European oak casks, seasoned in Jerez de la Frontera, Spain. The Macallan says each cask in this expression spent its entire maturation exclusively in sherry seasoned oak, and that the colour is entirely natural.
macallan-18-double-cask.casks: Sherry seasoned American and European oak, 18 years

royal-salute-25-year.about: Royal Salute presents its 25 Year Old, The Treasured Blend, as a tribute to the Crown Jewels of the British Monarchy: a collection of rare Scotch whiskies matured for 25 years in high quality oak casks, with a further four years in oak for added intensity. The US bottling is 40% ABV.
royal-salute-25-year.nose: Sweet stewed fruit and blueberry jam, with soft liquorice, a dusting of cinnamon and aromatic marzipan
royal-salute-25-year.palate: Intensely sweet, with juicy prunes, treacle toffee and dark chocolate, rounded off with caramelised figs
royal-salute-25-year.casks: Blend of 25 year old Scotch whiskies in oak, with a further four years in oak

hennessy-pure-white.about: Hennessy created Pure White in 1998 as a return to its roots, after 19th-century drinkers asked the house for some of the palest eaux-de-vie from Cognac. The blend is dominated by Fins Bois, and its eaux-de-vie show minimal wood influence so fresh floral and fruity notes come through. Hennessy recommends serving it over ice with fresh fruit juice or nectar.
hennessy-pure-white.casks: Fins Bois-dominant blend; minimal wood influence
